user_story:
As a mobile user, I want to browse products via a burger menu so that I can navigate the inventory easily on my device. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The burger menu can be opened by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-menu-btn'. 
2. The menu should include links to 'All Items' (data-test='inventory-sidebar-link'), 'About' (data-test='about-sidebar-link'), 'Logout' (data-test='logout-sidebar-link'), and 'Reset App State' (data-test='reset-sidebar-link'). 
3. The menu can be closed by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-cross-btn'.
